name: Hasbati Hijri Date Converter
author: hasbati

sections.description:
Hasbati Hijri Date Converter allows WordPress site owners and publishers to easily embed an interactive, accurate date conversion tool between the Islamic Hijri calendar (Umm al-Qura system) and the Gregorian calendar inside any post, page, or widget area using a simple shortcode.

All calculations run locally in the browser using standard modern JavaScript APIs without slowing down your website. This plugin is developed by the team at Hasbati and is powered by the official Hijri and Gregorian Date Converter methodology.

Key Features:

  • Dual Conversion: Convert dates seamlessly from Gregorian to Hijri and from Hijri to Gregorian.
  • Official Umm al-Qura Calendar: Accurate calculation of Islamic days, months, and years along with the exact weekday name.
  • Ultra-Fast Performance: Runs purely on native browser JavaScript with zero external library dependencies.
  • RTL & Arabic Interface Ready: Designed with a clean, responsive RTL Arabic user interface that fits mobile and desktop screens.

Shortcode Usage:

Add the following shortcode to any post, page, or widget:
[hasbati_date_converter]

To enable the optional attribution footer link:
[hasbati_date_converter credit=”yes”]
sections.installation:
1. Upload the hasbati-date-converter folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to ‘Settings -> محول التاريخ (حاسبتي)’ to copy the shortcode and configure options.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin affect website speed?

No, the plugin is extremely lightweight and only outputs inline HTML and native JavaScript on pages where the shortcode is actively used.

Which calendar system is used for conversion?

The calculator relies on the official Umm al-Qura calendar algorithm, matching the core engine used on the Hasbati Date Converter web application.
